effect.shortEffect: Boosts Attack after knocking out a Pokémon.
effect.full: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

japanese-kana.swsh: あいてを　たおすと つめたい　こえで　いなないて こうげきが　あがる。

korean.swsh: 상대를 쓰러뜨리면 차가운 울음소리를 내면서 공격이 올라간다.

traditional-chinese.swsh: 打倒對手時 會用冰冷的聲音嘶鳴 並提高攻擊。

french.swsh: Quand le Pokémon met un ennemi K.O., il émet un hennissement glaçant, ce qui augmente son Attaque.
french.sv: Quand le Pokémon met un ennemi K.O., il émet\nun hennissement glaçant, ce qui augmente son Attaque.

german.swsh: Besiegt es ein Pokémon, stößt es ein frostiges Wiehern aus und erhöht damit seinen Angriff.

spanish.swsh: Al derrotar a un objetivo, emite un relincho gélido y aumenta su Ataque.

italian.swsh: Quando manda KO il nemico, emette un nitrito agghiacciante, aumentando il proprio Attacco.

english.swsh: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.
english.sv: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.
